name: source-history-distinct-heads
goal: One source history read walks each distinct Git-returned branch head once, with unchanged branch lists, order and errors, and the next read sees moved refs.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: SourceHistoryRepository.reach ran git rev-list once per branch, repeating identical Git-listed heads (activity fixture: main and side share a tip). Count reduction only; not a confirmed 5 s timeout fix.

steps.title: Write and run a failing regression test; record the defect assertion and command.
steps.evidence: test/source-history-heads.test.ts (a9226876) on d66: 3/3 fail only on walks: 4 vs 2 (interleaved a/c, b/main heads), 4 vs 3 after a move, 5 vs 3 before an unwalkable orphan head; outputs and error already matched.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: reach(): a map living for one call from each Git-listed head to its walk, awaited in branch order; branch names, order, retained flags and errors unchanged; nothing shared across reads.

steps.title: Repeat repair and the same unchanged regression test until it passes; record passing proof.
steps.evidence: Same guard 3/3 green; d66 reach reintroduced in a copy 3/3 fail; repair restored 3/3 pass. Root typecheck, eslint, prettier, audit, units, scenarios, explain pass.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots; keep pending until proof passes.
